dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can use a wind glider.

dialogues.speaker: Henry Morton
dialogues.text: Forget it. I've been shut indoors ever since joining the Sumeru Akademiya. I haven't done any outdoor activities since.

dialogues.speaker: Henry Morton
dialogues.text: You can't really use your wind glider at the Akademiya either, so I've probably returned all my gliding instructor's teachings back to them...

dialogues.speaker: Henry Morton
dialogues.text: If you asked me to glide over there, I'd probably fall into the water halfway.
